decisions.reason: Margin analysis builds directly on the firm's maintained tariff and market-data databases and adds analytical value beyond plain tariff calculation, so the firm can interpret its results and refine it with its own R&D even as it consolidates other location-based tools.

The area definition tool draws on the firm's regional and network data know-how and serves as a building block for the central platform, though the 2024 withdrawals of related regional calculators raise some risk that it gets absorbed into the platform.

Site-specific tariff comparison uses the firm's existing databases, but the 2024 withdrawal of the closely related tariff calculators B, C and D and its low website visibility point to a substantial chance it will be merged into the platform, so it is kept for now under close review.
